title: Syriac Peshitta (New Testament), unvocalized Syriac script, one verse per line
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/syr/Peshitta/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module Peshitta). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 1,307,732 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'syriac') gives 571,359 characters. New Testament only (7,956 verses). Vowel points, where present, are combining marks and are stripped.
